notes.title: DLC Release and Prologue Update!
notes.notes:
[h2]Hello fellow preppers![/h2]

Today is the day! We are releasing our first DLC! On this occasion we invite you to watch the developer's stream! Also, we have released a big update with bug fixes and improvements! Please find the full change log below.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1882510/Mr_Prepper__Animal_Farm_DLC/

[h2]Also, there is a bundle Main game + DLC + OST available at lower price![/h2]

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/25279/Mr_Prepper__Anniversary_Edition/

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31521289/84974180d8c743ff72a468f48026b023cb8f4939.png[/img]

============================
[b]Prologue Changelog[/b]
============================
- Combat overhaul.
- Two-button attack system (left and right) or select a different attack style in game settings to fit your preferences. You can also switch back to the old combat system.
- Improved attack animations and effects.
- Added critical hits.
- Improved camera action during sequenced fights to eliminate excessive zooming in and out on waves of enemies.
- Added new combat tutorial
- Changed default key bind for weapon switch to F from Q. Q and E are now attack buttons by default.
- Texts with info about action keys now display actual current key binds.
- Changed the room-extending button to a more eye-catching color.
- Updated the calendar with days of the week and the ability to look at future and previous months.
- Workbench box is now a regular container, and you can put anything you want in there and disassemble items from there.
- Materials will now go straight to the player's inventory instead of workbench box when disassembling items.
- When crafting gear items, it will switch automatically to the gear tab in inventory.
- When disassembling an item that has multiple color variants, you will now get recipes for all color variants at once (for example, cups or pots). 
- You will no longer get stuck on forest paths in specific situations.
- During pause, Prepper will no longer charge a lot of dialogues to display at once.
- Few tweaks to item suspicion settings.
- Agent buff is now dependent on grade, not on total suspicion.
- Fixed agent buff not having a proper description.
- Few crafting recipe tweaks.
- Updated credits.
- Credits button added to main menu.
- Added weather to locations.
- Eat all mechanic is now available depending on the amount of food points or stamina given by the food (items that give a lot of points will not have eat all feature to prevent loss of items).
- Fixed a visual bug that occurred when the player moved equipped items directly onto the scene.
- Images on the scene will no longer cover dialogues (for example electricity icons).
- Improved the display of item weight to allow for more than two digits.
- Improved the changing of dialogue colors.
- Fixed the buff system to prevent situations where buff icons were not displayed correctly.
- When Prepper goes to bed, he receives the ""keep calm"" buff to prevent fainting before falling asleep.
- Fixed the functioning of trading during pause.
- Newspaper will not fall underground anymore.
- Quality of Life change - change of the trade layout to accommodate more items
- Radio has new function now - weather forecast;
- Improved display of the wilting icon on plants - removal of situations in which the icon was not displayed but should
- Improved fast stacking of items in boxes when moving them - fast relocation now correctly finds items to stack and stacks them together
- Fix prepper dialogue during Agent inspection that displayed at an inappropriate time after completing an agent's visit
- Eat all mechanics improved - now only eats enough to be full
- Improved automatic activation of dialogs by neighbors, which could sometimes interrupt other relevant dialogues
- Various minor UI tweaks.
- Other small tweaks and fixes



Wanna know more? Join our Discord for the community experience:

[url=https://discord.gg/BjuFWEr][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31521289/0ca3d5936b43ba2b7cd6274f7414ad7996cfff4b.png[/img][/url]

Truly yours,
Rejected Games

notes.title: Prologue Anniversary Update
notes.notes:
[h2]Hello, fellow preppers!
[/h2]
We are glad to announce that we have updated the Prologue version with the latest fixes from the main game. This means that all bugs and issues that we fixed in the main game are also fixed in the Prologue version. In addition, we decided to add some [b]new features [/b]due to the [b]1st anniversary[/b] we celebrate today. We added some customization options from the main game to the Prologue version! From now on, you are able to[b] customize your shelter[/b]. To do so, just click on the modification box in the corner of each room and select "Customize". You will be able to select some wallpapers we prepared.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38069527/b4f3ebd877f90c8a8739926b4d0dff4a2ac83c5d.gif[/img]



[h2]We are also glad to announce that the 1st DLC is on its way![/h2]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1882510/Mr_Prepper__Animal_Farm_DLC/

In addition, we would like to share a roadmap of the upcoming schedule for the main game:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38069527/ccbc454d71e2aab971f5b25b7a6ee2df47774507.png[/img]

In this update we also changed/fixed the fallowing things:

[list]
[*] New customization mechanics of shelter rooms: possibility of changing textures of rooms, walls and ceilings. Uncloking new textures through achievements.

[*] Plants will now show an alert symbol before they wither
[*] Light switches in the Prepper's house are now interactive
[*] Fixed possibility of tutorial lock/stuck
[*] Fix of the wrongly placed tutorial arrow during the first trade
[*] Fix of the wrongly highlighted tree logs in the woods during the tutorial
[*] Fix of the issues related to item splitting
[*] Removed a possibility to disassemble items inside the stove
[*] Removed the black screen after the intro that required an action to move on
[*] Prepper will no longer reload a weapon each morning and after every weapon change
[*] Fix of the possibility of generating big trees in the woods that might cover important elements
[*] Fix of the looping of some enemies sounds when they were blocked on obstacles
[*] Fix of the incorrect materials on some items (e.g. newspaper glowing in the dark)
[*] Items that respawn in the locations are no longer able to do so onto items left by a player (eg. logs spawning on the traps)
[*] Fix of the incorrect behaviour of light switches during a blackout
[*] Fix of the incorrect negative dialogue of the Agent when there was nothing suspicious
[*] Small fixes of gravity behaviour of some items in the cabin in the woods
[*] Fix of bugs related to the paths in the woods (blocking, next scene loading too quickly)
[*] Chinese text will now show with a proper speed
[*] Fix of the visual glitches caused by mist in some locations
[*] Better adjustment of the music in the intro
[*] Fix of the issue in which the number of items to be crafted was reset to 1 when Prepper got close to the workbench
[*] Other small fixes
[/list]

notes.title: RELEASE DATE AND TRAILER
notes.notes:
[h2][b]Greetings to all preppers![/b][/h2]

Dust off your trench-coats and fasten your seatbelts, here's an update you want to read!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31521289/79e91a99b91825a49091463b721c1d8b77b15632.gif[/img]

Mr. Prepper will be released on [b]18.03.2021[/b] (18th of March, 2021)!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/761830/Mr_Prepper/
This is, of course, later than we had originally intended. We realize many of you have been waiting eagerly to play the game. Creating Mr. Prepper we do not want to cut back on the quality and content of the game. Therefore, we believe delaying the game in the past was our best decision to create the best game we can. We believe many of you will agree with us on this one:

“[i]A delayed game is eventually good, but a rushed game is forever bad[/i]“
- Shigeru Miyamoto

And without further ado... the official release trailer!
[previewyoutube=gDSAcdf_498;full][/previewyoutube]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31521289/d1ad6669438300fad4a4d1169bd2932b7a10a389.gif[/img]

As a reward for your priceless support and patience, we came up with a little challenge for our community!
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/761830/view/2954891223959855039


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31521289/c7ab2ee2ffd541c7c5f8fd90a102f6a049463663.gif[/img]

Before the release date we will be doing some streams! We will show you parts of the full game, tell you about our plans for the game after release and have some Q&A. Stay tuned in on [url=https://discord.gg/BjuFWEr]discord[/url] to know when we are live!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31521289/9e34f70caf0e8d47b571e77e699b55ae4c94880c.gif[/img]

Of course, we will be supporting you all after the release! Please come over to our discord with your questions, found bugs and everything else.

---

We hope that reading about this news makes you as excited as us! This is the final countdown, and we are confident this date will not change!

Wanna know more? Join our Discord for a more of a community experience:

https://discord.gg/BjuFWEr

Truly yours,
[i]Rejected Games[/i]

notes.title: Mr. Prepper: Prologue - RELEASE STREAM
notes.notes:
Greetings to all Preppers!

We are happy to announce that the Mr. Prepper: Prologue wil be out tommorow and you can get it totally for free!

Due to this occasion we are going to do a developer stream! You will be able to watch it on the main Mr. Prepper and Mr. Prepper: Prologue steam pages and also on a PlayWay Youtube channel (27.08.2020 - 6 PM UK / 10 AM PDT / 7 PM CEST) here:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-X9mro1TAmY

[b]Visit the Prologue Steam Page by clicking here:[/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1340530/Mr_Prepper_Prologue/

What is Prologue? Mr. Prepper: Prologue is a free standalone version of the game Mr. Prepper, featuring an essential part of the story. The game contains the very beginning of the main game and allows you to get into the world of Mr. Prepper so you will be fully prepared before the final product release! :)

What is the difference between the demo and the prologue?

The demo allows you to play with the bunker and get familiar with the bunker mechanics.
The prologue contains everything what demo does, but also allows you to begin the story and other early-game mechanics of Mr. Prepper game. It's a good oportunity to prepare yourself and learn how to play before the main game comes!

So... What you're waiting for? Go and check the Prologue!

Wanna know more? Join our Discord for a more of a community experience:

https://discord.gg/BjuFWEr

Kind regards,
Rejected Games.
